rationale: Iran Strait of Hormuz blasts and US supply route blockade represent escalation that could affect regional security and Western focus on Ukraine aid.

top_events.title: Iran war live: Blasts heard in Qeshm; US moves to block land supply routes
top_events.label: Blasts reported in Iran Strait of Hormuz
